2607.00576.title: Safe Alone, Unsafe Together: Safeguarding Against Implicit Toxicity When Benign Images Combine
2607.00576.paper_summary: Multi-image content has become an increasingly prevalent form of visual communication in social media, giving rise to a new safety issue, multi-image implicit toxicity (MIIT), where each image appears benign in isolation, but harmful semantics emerge when the images are interpreted jointly. MIIT is particularly challenging for existing commercial moderation APIs and models due to the lack of explicit risky cues in each image. This paper aims to study how to identify MIIT. We first provide a formal definition of MIIT and analyze three key challenges for its detection. To alleviate the scarcity of data in this area, we construct MIIT-dataset, an image-only multi-image safety dataset covering seven representative risk categories through an automatic generation pipeline. Finally, we train MiShield with progressively distilled reasoning supervision, enabling it to produce safety judgments accompanied by explicit analyses of the correlated entities that result in the hazards. Experiments show that MiShield-8B models outperform representative moderation services and even larger-scale models, revealing its effectiveness and practical value for this widely used visual format. Warning: This paper contains potentially sensitive content.
2607.00576.paper_summary_zh: 多圖像內容已成為社交媒體中越來越普遍的視覺交流形式，並引發了一個新的安全問題，即多圖像隱含毒性 (MIIT)，在這種情況下，每個圖像單獨看似無害，但當這些圖像共同解讀時，卻會出現有害的語義。由於每個圖像中缺乏明確的風險提示，MIIT 對現有的商業審核 API 和模型特別具有挑戰性。本文旨在研究如何識別 MIIT。我們首先提供 MIIT 的正式定義，並分析其檢測的三個主要挑戰。為了緩解該領域數據的稀缺性，我們構建了 MIIT-dataset，這是一個僅包含圖像的多圖像安全數據集，通過自動生成管道涵蓋七個代表性的風險類別。最後，我們使用逐步提煉的推理監督訓練 MiShield，使其能夠生成安全判斷，並附上導致危害的相關實體的明確分析。實驗顯示，MiShield-8B 模型的表現超過了代表性的審核服務，甚至比更大規模的模型更為優越，顯示出其在這種廣泛使用的視覺格式中的有效性和實際價值。警告：本文包含潛在敏感內容。
